message.content: {"report": "## Decision note: Maple storage options as of 20 July 2026\n\nS1 caps first-year cost at 10 units, recovery at 4 hours, requires on-premises data, and states current storage is 12 TB; 4 TB next-year growth is only a forecast (S1). A totals 11 units (8+3), breaching budget; B totals 8 units (5+3) but restores in 5 hours, breaching recovery (S2). Both are infeasible now. C totals 8 units (6+2), restores in 3 hours, holds 14 TB, and is on premises (S2). Against current requirements, C alone satisfies budget, recovery, location and present capacity. Neither source supplies preference weights, so no exception or ranking by unstated criteria is claimed. Recommend C. Before growth exceeds capacity, verify C's expansion price and post-expansion recovery time, currently unknown (S2), and confirm storage need against the forecast rather than treating 4 TB growth as a current minimum (S1).", "notes": "Source scope: S1 and S2 only. Word count of report: 152 whitespace-separated words (within 120-170). Requirements checked: compares three options; current budget/recovery/location/capacity; recommends C; says what to check before growth; separates current 12 TB from 4 TB forecast; cites S1/S2; no invented weights or approved exceptions. Calculations: A 8+3=11 >10; B 2h? no, 5h >4; C 6+2=8 <=10, 3h <=4, 14TB >=12TB current. Caveat: C expansion price/expanded recovery unknown, so future growth feasibility unverified."}
